description: HMS graph construction on writerslogic-02 (WSL2, Intel Core Ultra 9 185H): 10-thread builds pinned with taskset -c 12-21 under a timing lock, public-bench ann-qgraph --index vertex --degree 64 --build-ef 500 --quantized-search; SIFT-1M uses 8-bit vertex codes, rerank 32,64; glove-100 4-bit vertex codes, rerank 64. Single runs; other sessions shared the host, so QPS varies between runs of one graph (compare recall and estimates per query across graphs; a graph_hash match means a bit-identical graph). PHASE fields: wall, greedy/prune CPU seconds, fresh = construction estimates, exact = exact distances.
